summary.root_cause_text: The order worker thread got stuck in a wait state and stopped consuming the queue. The deeper reason is unknown. Config and recent changes show nothing wrong.
recommended: Investigate why the worker enters the wait state and doesn't wake up. Add an alert on a stalled worker or growing queue depth.

args.impact: Orders were queued but not processed. At the last reading before the fix, 37 orders were waiting, worth 26736.73 SAR in total (SAR 6087.54 and USD 5506.45). No orders were dropped, none were processed without payment, and there were no ledger issues. After the restart, all 74 orders were processed and paid, and the queue was empty.
